actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects state energy offices, electric utilities, and local distribution system operators across participating states.
Requires states to update energy security plans to address physical threats, cyber threats, and supply chain risks for local distribution systems to remain eligible for federal financial assistance.
dimensions.evidence: require States to include supporting the physical security, cybersecurity, and resilience of local distribution systems in State energy security plans

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing federal financial assistance programs tied to state energy conservation and security plans through FY2031.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall expire on September 30, 2031.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Energy Policy and Conservation Act to broaden planning mandates, alter DOE review requirements, and mandate a GAO efficacy report.
dimensions.evidence: Section 366 of the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (42 U.S.C. 6326) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends the statutory section's authorization and planning requirements until the sunset date of September 30, 2031.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall expire on September 30, 2031.

missing_information: Specific funding amounts allocated for state energy security plan grants

importance_detail.rationale: Modifies state energy security plan requirements to include local distribution systems, physical security, cybersecurity, and supply chain risks, extending the program through FY2031.
